segments.name: hook
segments.text: System breach detected. We just intercepted the complete global smartphone market share data for twenty twenty five. Here is the classified breakdown.

segments.name: setup
segments.text: Generating the three-D data core. Six slices of market dominance about to be exposed. Watch the donut render in real time.

segments.name: slice_1
segments.text: Apple takes the massive lead with thirty five percent of global shipments. An undisputed leader in the premium segment. The biggest slice of the pie by far.

segments.name: slice_2
segments.text: Samsung holds strong at twenty five percent. A powerful global presence across every price tier. Still the number two threat in the market.

segments.name: slice_3
segments.text: Xiaomi surges in with fifteen percent. Fast growth, aggressive pricing, and massive traction in Asia. A serious contender in the value segment.

segments.name: slice_4
segments.text: Oppo carves out ten percent. Heavy dominance in Asian markets with a growing foothold overseas. Quietly climbing the ranks.

segments.name: slice_5
segments.text: Vivo locks in eight percent. Offline retail strength and solid mid-range offerings keep it firmly in the game.

segments.name: slice_6
segments.text: The remaining seven percent goes to Other brands. Combined smaller players fighting for every fraction of the pie. Volatile, unpredictable, but still in the race.

segments.name: winner
segments.text: The undisputed heavyweight of this breakdown is Apple. Thirty five percent of the entire global smartphone market. No one even comes close.

segments.name: outro
segments.text: Core shutdown. Data secured. Follow for the next market intelligence drop.
